questions.question: What is the discount percentage equivalent to three successive discounts of 12%, 10% and 5%?
questions.solution:
Let, the MP be 100

SP become after three discount = 100 × (88/100) × (90/100) × (95/100) = 75.24

∴ Single equivalent discount is = [(100 - 75.24)/100] × 100 = 24.76%

**Short Trick:**

Single equivalent discount of 12% and 10% = 12 + 10 - [(12 × 10)/100] = 20.8%

Single equivalent discount of 20.8% and 5% = 20.8 + 5 - [(20.8 × 5)/100] = 24.76%

questions.question: It is given that the 10-digit number 55y1725x00 is exactly divisible by 88. What is the value of (y - x)?
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 - 3 + 4 - 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

Divisibility law of 8: A number divisible by 8 if its last three digit is divisible by 8

10-digit number 55y1725x00 is divisible by 88 so we can say number also divisible by 11 and 8.

Check the divisibility by 11, then

5 - 5 + y - 1 + 7 - 2 + 5 - x + 0 - 0 = 11

17 + y - 8 - x = 11

y - x = 11 - 9

y - x = 2

questions.question: If 15 men can complete a work in 16 days by working 8 hours daily, then in how many days will 10 men complete the work by working 12 hours daily?

As we know,

15 × 16 × 8 = 10 × D₂ × 12

questions.question: a, b, c, d, e are five numbers such that their average is 38. The average of b, c, d is 17, e is less than a by one. What is the value of e?
questions.solution:
Average of a, b, c, d and e is = 38

Sum of a, b, c, d and e = 38 × 5 = 190

Average of b, c and d = 17

Sum of b, c and d = 17 × 3 = 51

As we know, e is less than a by one, then

a = e + 1

According to the question

a + e = (a + b + c + d + e) - (b + c)

⇒ a + e = 190 - 51

⇒ a + e = 139

⇒ e + 1 + e = 139

⇒ 2e = 139 - 1 = 138

⇒ e = 138/2

∴ e = 69

questions.question: A man travels a distance of 4 km every day. One day he increases his speed by 0.8 km/h than usual speed and reaches his destination 15 minutes earlier. What is the normal speed of the man?
questions.solution:
Let speed of the man be x km/hr

**Short Trick:**

[x × (x + 0.8)]/0.8 × [15/60] = 4

⇒ x (x + 0.8) = 12.8

Put x = 3.2 (with the help of option or taking unit digit help]

⇒ 3.2 × 4 = 12.8

⇒ 12.8 = 12/8 (satisfied)

∴ Normal speed of the man = 3.2 km/hr

**Detailed Method:**

According to the question

[4/x] - [4/(x + 0.8)] = 15/60

⇒ 4 [x + 0.8 - x]/x(x + 0.8) = ¼

⇒ 12.8 = x² + 0.8x

⇒ x² + 0.8x - 12.8 = 0

⇒ x² - 3.2x + 4x - 12.8 = 0

⇒ x (x - 3.2) + 4 (x - 3.2) = 0

⇒ (x + 4) (x - 3.2) = 0

Taking,

(x - 3.2) = 0 (as speed can’t be negative)

⇒ x = 3.2

∴ Normal speed of the man = 3.2 km/hr

questions.question: Which among the given numbers are exactly divisible by 7, 11 and 13?
questions.solution:
**Proof:**

Six digit number repeated its three digit divisible by 7, 11 and 13.

Let the six digit number repeated its three digit is xyzxyz

We can write this

1000 × xyz + 1 × xyz

xyz (1000 + 1)

xyz × 1001

Now we can say xyzxyz is divisible by 1001 and 1001 = 7 × 11 × 13, so the number xyzxyz also divisible by 7, 11 and 13.

questions.question: A train goes from P to Q with an average speed of u km/h and returns from Q to P with an average speed of v km/h. What is its average speed for the entire journey in km/h?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Average speed formula = 2uv/(u + v)

**Proof:**

Let distance between P and Q be d km

As we know,

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

Average speed = 2d/(d/u + d/v) = 2uv/(u + v)

questions.question: The average of a series of five numbers, in which each term is greater than its previous term by 3, is 12. What is the value of the greatest term?
questions.solution:
Let first number be x, then

Then second, third, fourth and fifth numbers will be (x + 3), (x + 6), (x + 9) and (x + 12) respectively.

Average of 5 numbers = 12

Hence, sum of 5 numbers = 12 × 5 = 60

According to the question

x + x + 3 + x + 6 + x + 9 + x + 12 = 60

⇒ 5x + 30 = 60

⇒ 5x = 60 - 30

⇒ 5x = 30

⇒ x = 30/5

⇒ x = 6

∴ The greatest number = x + 12 = 6 + 12 = 18

questions.question: It is given that ΔABC ~ ΔEDF and Area ΔABC : Area ΔEDF = 64 : 25. If AB = 16 cm, BC = 18 cm, CA = 20 cm. What is the value of EF (in cm)?
questions.solution:
ΔABC ~ ΔEDF

As we know,

ar ΔABC/arΔEDF = (AC/EF)²

questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus are respectively 6 cm and 10 cm. What is the area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
Diagonal of rhombus, d₁ = 6 cm

Diagonal of rhombus, d₂ = 10 cm

As we know,

Area of rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 6 × 10 = 30 cm²

questions.question: The total marks for a subject in an examination was 200. It had three components- theory, practical and project, the percentage weightages for the first and the third being 50 and 10 respectively. One of the criteria to pass the examination was to secure at least 60%, in practical. A student secured 42 in practical. How much percentage of the total marks should be given to him as grace so that he passes to exam?
questions.solution:
Total marks for a subject in an examination = 200

Percentage weightages for practical = 100% - 50% - 10% = 40%

Number of weightage for practical = 200 × (40/100) = 80

Required pass marks to pass in practical = 80 × (60/100) = 48

Student gets in practical = 42 marks

Required numbers of grace to pass in the practical = 48 - 42 = 6

∴ Required percentage = (6/200) × 100 = 3%
